purpose: Every 2004 free agent by the club holding his rights on June 30, 2004 (world data, researched October 2026). Read by Miami's 2004 free agency only for players' status on the date; a real Miami player is flagged real_miami_player.

research.usage: World data (option D), research draft: real 2004 free agents by rights-holding club on June 30, 2004, and the real July 1 - November 2, 2004 signings, offer sheets, matches, sign-and-trades, rookie signings, trades and waivers. Rows with involves_miami or real_miami_player are real Miami facts, which the simulation skips (rule 1); they are kept as the alternatives simulated Miami competes against. No row may be read by Miami's front office before its date. No 2004-05 game results are included.

status_legend.derived: computed or inferred from sourced facts; the reasoning is given in the row
status_legend.unverified: could not be confirmed; value null or left as reported with a note

sources.use: ESPN.com "2004 NBA free agents", June 29, 2004, updated July 7: the team-by-team restricted/unrestricted/other list. Primary source for free_agent_rights.
All dated signings (excluding same-club re-signings), trades and waivers July 2004 - June 2005; read for 2004-07-01 to 2004-11-02.
Free-agency table (includes re-signings, offer-sheet matches), draft-pick signing dates, undrafted signings. Secondary; contains errors (e.g. Hoiberg listed as from Chicago).
Per-player contract histories: option decisions, signing dates, years and totals. Found with 2004 entries for about 90 players; many older pages are incomplete.
2004-05 salaries (rosters of 2004-12-20): first-year salary of contracts signed in the window. Later list used only to read an existing contract term.
bbr_id verification, birth dates (data-birth), seasons with games.
Period news (AP, ESPN Insider) for terms, re-signings and option decisions; index https://www.espn.com/nba/feature/featureStory?page=nbafreeagency04

signings_kind_legend.signing: free agent signs with a club other than the one holding his rights (or with no rights holder)
signings_kind_legend.re_sign: free agent signs with the club holding his rights
signings_kind_legend.offer_sheet: restricted free agent signs another club's offer sheet (from = rights holder, to = offering club)
signings_kind_legend.match: rights holder matches the offer sheet (from = to = rights holder)
signings_kind_legend.match_declined: rights holder declines to match; player joins the offering club (from = rights holder, to = offering club)
signings_kind_legend.sign_and_trade: rights holder signs the player and trades him the same day (from = signing club, to = acquiring club); the trade is also under trades
signings_kind_legend.qualifying_offer_accepted: restricted free agent signs his one-year qualifying offer
signings_kind_legend.rookie_signing: 2004 draft pick signs his first contract
signings_kind_legend.undrafted_rookie_signing: player who went undrafted in 2004 signs

scope: Every player on ESPN.com's 2004 free-agent list (June 29, updated July 7, 2004) under "Restricted" or "Unrestricted", by the club holding his rights; players listed under "Other" (non- or partially guaranteed 2004-05 contracts) are kept separately in other_listed and are not free agents. Facts only: no cap holds or qualifying-offer amounts are computed here.
assumptions: Years of service are counted as seasons with at least one NBA regular-season game before 2004-05 (Basketball-Reference); a season under contract without a game is not counted.
The ESPN list is the published list as updated July 7, 2004; a player who opted out after that update or whose contract history shows an expiry without being listed is not added.
prior_salary_2003_04 comes from the Bender list of January 1, 2004; players signed later in the season or released before then have null.
Restricted status is as listed by ESPN; whether a qualifying offer was tendered is not established except where a match or offer sheet shows it.
unverified: Qualifying-offer tenders and amounts for restricted free agents (only Stromile Swift accepting his $5,993,105 qualifying offer is sourced, ShamSports).
Option outcomes are recorded only where a source states them; other free agents are assumed to have had plain expiring contracts.
Jon Stefansson and Josh Moore have no Basketball-Reference NBA player page.

option_decisions_not_free_agents.note: Date from AP text reproduced on a forum; ESPN July 15 confirms Payton announced he would return.
